title: ACTREC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Genomic Assistant Posts
description: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for various Genomic Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Post Graduation, M.Sc. Nursing, or MSW can grab this chance and apply for the ACTREC Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidate...
